classic.init: th06.v1.02h/state/data/functions.jsonl:00416d60 BulletManager__on_registration; main script table 0x46a6e8; template grazeSize at +0x550/+0x554
classic.collision: Classic native player collision is axis-aligned box overlap; radius stores the scalar half-size for the target circle model, not full geometry equivalence.
classic.alpha: Both classic *_a.png masks are RGB with equal R/G/B channels and extrema 0..255; use one channel as the alpha mask.

nc.logical_dimension_source: NC ANM sprite record +0x14/+0x18 override logical width/height. A zero override uses f32(pixel_extent*480/1080).
nc.init: 0x140011f80: plVar3 starts at bulletManager+0xff710; plVar3[2] is vm+0x100; 0x14001223e MOVSS XMM0,[RCX+0x1c] reads logical height. grazeSize is written at bulletManager+type*0x5b0+0xffbc4/+0xffbc8.
nc.spawn: 0x14000f870 copies template grazeSize to bullet+0x5f4/+0x5f8 before applying source palette sprite offset.
nc.consumer: 0x140010870 passes bullet+0x5f4 to 0x14006a980 Player__CalcKillBoxCollision with mode=1; bullet circle radius=min(grazeSize.x,grazeSize.y)/2, native player radius=1.25.
nc.correction: The early investigation mislabeled Sprite+0x1c as pixel height by overlooking the Sprite base at manager+0x608. Absolute offsets and SetActiveSprite resolve it: +0x1c is logical height. NC radii match classic; enlarged texture rectangles do not enlarge collision.

evidence.palette_scope: Counts describe consecutive source sprite slots belonging to each shape. Spawn directly adds signed color to base sprite, without bounds validation; slots beyond the group are not promoted to valid colors. FIREBALL slots 118..121 are frames of one red animation, not four independent hues; shipped NC ECL uses initial offsets 0 and 1. Native script overwrites sprite every five frames.
evidence.rotation_scope: Directional sprite scripts set autoRotate=1. Classic draw uses pi/2-angle; first-frame rice/kunai/shard/dagger point up in the source art. Fireball also auto-rotates but has a soft flame outline.
not_verified: No native game execution or dynamic collision probe.
No external mod/asset override directory was inspected.
Birth slowdown and no-hit windows are intentionally outside this radius/source-frame catalog.

reproduce.requirements: Existing local source archives/exe/exports plus six classic etama3/etama4 .anm/.png/*_a.png files extracted by existing thdat. Uses existing tooling/pe_read.py with explicit PE32/PE32+ image-base read; does not modify that shared tool.
